$comment: sherpa-outlet — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: where the route's Context is drawn. It is the app's main landmark, and its light DOM IS the Context: on each route change it loads the one app.json names, runs it, and tears the last one down. TRAP T-an-outlet-loads-the-context

slots.description: the Context's markup, put there by the outlet

capabilities.description: read/write JS properties (context, settingsPage, viewsReady). See $extensions.sherpa.jsProps.
callable from a view definition's state block (viewsOf, firstView, refreshNav, start). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

methods.name: viewsOf
methods.description: A Context's Views: its own, then the reader's saved ones.

methods.name: firstView
methods.description: Its first View, which the URL leaves out.

methods.name: refreshNav
methods.description: Draw the nav again — after a View is saved or deleted, say.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Read app.json, load each Context's Views, then open the route's Context. The router's `context` defaults to the app's own.
